description: Get a cited, time-stamped real-world fact for any place on Earth. Use it for: current weather or temperature, river level or flood status, earthquakes near a place, disasters, air quality (AQI), and US weather alerts. Example questions: 'Is it raining in Lagos?', 'Is the river high at Baton Rouge?', 'Any earthquakes near Tokyo today?'. Every answer returns fact, place, time, source_url, age_seconds, stale and confidence. Not connected yet (it says so instead of guessing): road closures, power outages, burn bans. Free, no sign-up.

max_age_minutes.description: Mark answers older than this as stale

place.description: Any place name, e.g. 'Lafayette' or 'Lagos, Nigeria'; or use lat+lon

topic.description: One of: weather, weather_alerts, river_level, flood, earthquakes, disasters, air_quality, road_closures, power_outages, burn_ban (or give free text in q and the topic is guessed). Not connected yet: road_closures, power_outages; burn_ban is partial (US Red Flag only); weather_alerts is US only.

name: ground_truth_ask
title: Ask a public fact
